question: The Corner Cafe tracks its coffee beans in grams, though the roaster invoices by the kilogram and the owner knows a thousand grams make a kilogram. Each bag arrives with 121 grams of beans and the roaster tops it up with 39 grams before sealing it. A box holds 4 bags plus 63 grams of loose beans in a sachet, and the cafe took delivery of 4 boxes, which made up its entire store of beans. During the week the baristas used 1723 grams from the store, and then another 345 grams for a catering order. How many grams of beans are left in the store?

Ezra arrived at the fun fair with 74 game tokens and used 73 of them on the bumper cars. A lucky-spin machine then tripled the tokens he had left. He won 73 tokens at the ring toss and 7 more at the duck pond. How many tokens does Ezra have now?

At a cereal factory that has run for a dozen years, Rafa fills each box with 165 grams of flakes and Tam adds 63 grams of nuts, so Rafa puts more into every box than Tam does. The boxes are packed 9 to a carton, the cartons 6 to a pallet, and the pallets 9 to a truck. The factory employs 40 workers. Today 8 full trucks left the loading dock. How many grams of cereal left the factory today?

In the morning the nursery's mint trays each held 74 plants, and Kit pricked out 51 more plants into each tray, filling 5 trays that made up the whole stock. In the afternoon 292 plants were sold at the plant fair. In the evening Kit divided every plant left in the stock into 6 rooted cuttings, each potted up as a new plant, and a neighbour dropped off 15 potted mint plants for the stock. How many mint plants are in the stock now?

In the morning each pump at the Redhill water station ran for 4 hours at 200 litres an hour, and then 357 litres of each pump's output went to the fire trucks, leaving each pump's daily amount. In the afternoon the manager counted 5 pumps working exactly that way. The station ran that way every day for 7 days, and by the evening of the last day 5974 litres of the week's water had been sold to a farm. How many litres of water does the station have left from the week?

The Brasswood band books a 209-minute slot for each rehearsal, but 103 minutes of it goes on setting up and 21 minutes on a break, so only the rest is playing time. The band rehearses 4 times a week and also plays a 76-minute concert each week. The hall charges by the hour rather than the minute, so the treasurer knows sixty minutes make an hour and converts the totals later. How many minutes of playing time does the band get over 4 weeks?

Bo delivers groceries and counts his earnings in cents, though he knows a hundred cents make a dollar and will convert when he banks it. For each delivery he receives 21 cents from Mr Pao, the shop owner, and a 59-cent tip from the customer, Mrs Ng, so Mrs Ng gives him more per delivery than Mr Pao does. Bo makes 6 deliveries an hour, works 3 hours a shift, and did 4 shifts this week. He then spent 73 cents on a snack. How many cents does Bo have left from the week?

Pam bakes 89 cookies every morning for her stall, but 42 go unsold each day and are given to the shelter, so only the rest count as sales. She kept that up for 7 days. Her friend Joe sold 67 cookies at his own stall over the same week, far fewer than Pam, and they pooled all the cookies they had sold into one tally. Each cookie sells for 3 dollars. They then split the tally equally between the 2 of them to work out how many sales each should be credited with. How many cookie sales is Joe credited with?

A delivery company splits its 220-kilometre daily route equally among 4 drivers, and the dispatcher logs distances in kilometres although the vans' odometers show metres, a thousand of which make a kilometre. Each driver covers a share of that route on 4 days a week. Wren, one of the drivers, kept that schedule for 8 weeks, though she was off for half a day once and caught up later. Of Wren's total for those weeks, 770 kilometres were actually driven by a substitute while her van was serviced. How many kilometres did Wren drive herself over the 8 weeks?

In the morning the Ashford grain mill loaded each cart with 4 sacks of 44 kilograms and then tipped in 78 kilograms of loose grain, and it sent out 7 carts like that every hour. In the afternoon the foreman confirmed the mill had run at that rate for 7 hours that day. In the evening he noted that the mill had done exactly the same on each of 6 days that week, and then took in a 20-kilogram sack returned by a customer. How many kilograms of grain did the mill handle that week, counting the returned sack?

In the morning 47 children arrived at the summer camp, then 53 more came on the second bus and 80 on the third. In the afternoon the organisers counted that 4 camps of exactly that size were meeting at the park. In the evening all of those children were split equally into 6 teams for the campfire games. How many children are on each team?

A relief group had 153 blankets in each of its warehouses, and a donor tripled the number in every warehouse. Then 136 blankets were handed out from each warehouse during the cold snap. The group has 7 warehouses, all stocked and used identically. A school then collected 36 blankets and a church collected 65, and both lots were added to the group's total. How many blankets does the relief group have now?

Each of Wes's 4 photo albums has 176 slots, but 96 slots in every album are empty, and the rest hold one photo each. His cousin Lia gave him 48 loose photos, a smaller number than Wes already had. Wes then printed a second copy of every photo he had, so he had 2 of each. He later bought 68 postcards to keep with the photos. How many photos and postcards does Wes have now?

A syrup maker keeps track of its stock in millilitres, converting to litres only for the shipping forms, since a thousand millilitres make a litre. Each bottle is filled with 235 millilitres and then 22 millilitres is drawn off as a quality sample. The bottles are packed 8 to a crate and 7 crates to a pallet, and 3 pallets make up the whole stock. A cooling failure then spoiled 9923 millilitres of the stock, which was poured away. How many millilitres of syrup are in the stock now?

Ray gathered 213 conkers from under the horse chestnut tree, and 5 of them split when they fell. His friend Sol brought 52 conkers of his own, far fewer than Ray had, and tipped them into Ray's bag. The 4 friends in their gang then shared the bag equally, which took half an hour of counting. Sol found 4 more conkers on the walk home and kept them. How many conkers does Sol have now?

In the morning the road trip was planned to take 100 minutes, but a shortcut cut 20 minutes off, and the driving was divided equally among the 4 friends in the car, which has 5 seats. In the afternoon Ines drove her share plus 10 extra minutes because of roadworks. In the evening she drove exactly the same amount again on the way back, so her total driving for the day was 2 times her afternoon amount. She logs her driving in minutes, though the insurance form asks for hours and she knows sixty minutes make an hour. How many minutes did Ines drive that day?

In the morning Nico packed 58 grapes in his lunch box, and his friend Ada, who had only 54 grapes and so slightly fewer than Nico, tipped hers into his box so he could carry them. At morning break Nico ate 41 grapes from the box. In the afternoon he gave 43 grapes to the football team. In the evening he ate 17 more on the bus home. How many grapes are left in Nico's lunch box?

The Riverbend chess club had 61 members in January, and 20 of them let their memberships lapse. During the spring drive Rin recruited 71 new members while Kai recruited 75, so Kai brought in more than Rin, and all of those recruits joined. The annual fee is 15 dollars. A merger with the library club then added 69 members. How many members does the chess club have now?

A vineyard block was planted with 215 vines, then 39 more were added, and 73 vines died in a frost. The grower then tripled the number of vines in the block by planting the empty land around it. A disease forced the removal of 267 vines. Each remaining vine yields 8 kilograms of grapes at harvest. How many kilograms of grapes will the block yield?

The school science storeroom received 2 crates of test tubes with 121 tubes in each, and those were all the tubes it had. During the first week 157 tubes were taken out for experiments, and 72 more went to the chemistry club. A supplier then delivered 40 tubes to the storeroom. Then 44 tubes were found cracked and thrown out. How many test tubes are in the storeroom now?

In the morning each of the 7 milk tanks at the Fenwick dairy held 218 litres, and 151 litres were drawn from every tank for the morning bottling. The dairy has 30 cows. In the afternoon 14 litres were added from a late milking, and then 408 litres were sold to the cheese maker. In the evening the neighbouring dairy reported exactly the same amount of milk left as Fenwick, so the co-op combined the 2 amounts for the night collection. How many litres of milk did the co-op collect that night?

Dana and Eli were fencing a paddock. Each roll of wire they opened held 152 metres; from every roll Dana used 68 metres and Eli used 28 metres, so Dana used more wire than Eli. They opened 3 rolls, used them all the same way, and kept the leftover wire from each roll in one pile. Their neighbour then handed over exactly as much wire as was in the pile, so the pile became 2 times as long. How many metres of wire are in the pile now?

The island ferry has 193 seats. On each crossing this week 106 seats were taken by commuters, 47 by tourists and 8 by crew members, and the rest stayed empty. The ferry makes the crossing twice a day. Over 5 days at that rate, how many empty seats were there in total?

In the morning the rental shack had 24 kayaks lined up on the beach, and 32 more were unloaded from the truck. In the afternoon 53 kayaks came back from a group tour and 22 came back from private renters. In the evening 95 kayaks were loaded onto trailers for winter storage. How many kayaks are left on the beach?

The sports club measures juice in millilitres, though the supplier sells it by the litre and everyone knows a thousand millilitres make a litre. In the morning the volunteers poured 191 millilitres into each of the 6 cups on a tray and filled 9 trays, then emptied all of it equally into 6 coolers. In the afternoon the players drank 1684 millilitres from the red cooler. In the evening the coach topped up the red cooler so that it held 3 times what had been left in it. How many millilitres of juice are in the red cooler now?
